statement: Revised research plan and conditional-model audit: success probability is capped at one before optimizing arity or batching. The rational numeric instances and current integer parameter checks are separately certified; they do not establish actual algorithm cost or an exponent improvement. The existing four-coset class lower bound exceeds the unit-constant sixth-root target, and the chosen gamma3/2 unit-budget model at that bound cannot certify the finite reference cost; this is not an asymptotic impossibility claim. Many-coset products are arithmetic proposals awaiting admissibility, transport, recognition-cost and growing-family checks. The plan prioritizes fixed-base batch algorithms, four/six arity comparisons, exact proof bridges and scoped rejection criteria. Novelty and a real decomposition advantage remain open.
